taskDescription: Drag each source into the correct position to show where the atoms of the purine ring come from.
textField: In de novo purine synthesis, N1 comes from *aspartate*, C2 and C8 come from *N10-formyl-THF*, N3 and N9 come from *glutamine*, C4, C5 and N7 come from *glycine*, and C6 comes from *CO₂*.

overallFeedback.feedback: The purine ring is assembled from five different small-molecule donors: aspartate (N1), N10-formyl-THF (C2, C8), glutamine (N3, N9), glycine (C4, C5, N7) and CO₂ (C6). This is why methotrexate, which blocks folate recycling, starves rapidly dividing cells of the one-carbon units needed for C2 and C8.
